meta.description: Registry for recursive divergence, oscillation, and nontermination failure modes in Phase 3.

failure_modes.name: recursive_divergence
failure_modes.description: The system state Grows without bound under recursive application.

failure_modes.name: infinite_branch_growth
failure_modes.description: Multi-valued continuation generates branches at a rate exceeding pruning capacity.

failure_modes.name: residue_amplification_loop
failure_modes.description: Residue updates create a positive feedback loop leading to state divergence.

failure_modes.name: transport_closure_leakage
failure_modes.description: Recursive transport eventually maps states outside of all admissible neighborhoods.

failure_modes.name: orientation_drift_accumulation
failure_modes.description: Orientation deviation grows persistently across iterations, destroying basin stability.

failure_modes.name: admissibility_window_collapse
failure_modes.description: Recursive constraints result in the admissibility window shrinking to an empty set.

failure_modes.name: nonterminating_symbolic_reduction
failure_modes.description: Symbolic rewrite rules fail to reach a normal form under recursive depth scaling.

failure_modes.name: oscillatory_nonconvergence
failure_modes.description: The system state cycles between disparate values without reaching a stable basin or normal form.

failure_modes.name: recurrence_basin_escape
failure_modes.description: A process state previously within a stable basin is mapped outside of it under iteration.

failure_modes.name: false_convergence_due_to_overpruning
failure_modes.description: The system appears stable only because valid continuation paths have been incorrectly discarded.
